title: Markov Chain Convergence in Kernel-Induced Geometry
abstract: arXiv:2610.13916v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the convergence of Markov chains in the geometry induced by Hilbertian embeddings associated with positive definite kernels, also called Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD). Under a contraction assumption in the kernel-induced geometry, and a standard spectral gap assumption, we establish non-asymptotic, high-probability bounds for the convergence of the empirical occupation measure to the invariant measure. The obtained bounds separate the roles of the two conditions: the spectral gap determines the effective sample size in the leading term, while the kernel contraction enters only through a linear correction. As an application, we study one-step prediction of dynamical systems from a single trajectory, deriving fast learning rates for a nonlinear least-squares estimator. The rates highlight the interplay between mixing properties in the kernel-induced geometry and the classical source and capacity conditions used in the analysis

translated_title: 核诱导几何中的马尔可夫链收敛性
translated_abstract: 我们研究了马尔可夫链在与正定核相关联的希尔伯特嵌入所诱导的几何（也称为最大均值差异，MMD）中的收敛性。在核诱导几何中的收缩性假设和标准谱隙假设下，我们建立了经验占据测度向不变测度收敛的非渐近高概率界。所得到的界分离了这两个条件的作用：谱隙决定了首项中的有效样本量，而核收缩仅通过线性修正项进入。作为应用，我们研究了从单条轨迹出发的动力系统一步预测问题，为非线性最小二乘估计器导出了快速学习速率。这些速率突出了核诱导几何中的混合性质与分析中所用的经典源条件和容量条件之间的相互作用。
tldr: 该论文在核诱导几何的收缩性与谱隙假设下，建立了马尔可夫链经验占据测度收敛的非渐近高概率界，并将结果应用于单轨迹动力系统的一步预测，为非线性最小二乘估计器导出了快速学习速率。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes non-asymptotic high-probability bounds for Markov chain convergence under contraction and spectral gap assumptions in kernel-induced (MMD) geometry, and applies them to one-step prediction of dynamical systems from a single trajectory, deriving fast learning rates for nonlinear least-squares estimators.
